name: Amorable Beauty Salon
address: Al murraqabat road Flat# 101, Bu Haleeba Building, Murraqqabat - Road - near Asiana grand hotel - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Welcome to Amorable Beauty Salon—your escape into affordable luxury. Let our experts elevate your beauty with flawless hair styling, elegant nails, natural permanent makeup, soothing massages, and enchanting Moroccan treatments. Melt into relaxation with our Japanese Head Spa and renew your glow with our signature facials. Every visit feels special, every detail is crafted with care. At Amorable, beauty becomes an experience—luxurious, unforgettable, and made just for you.

reviews.author: Mark Louie Mendoza
reviews.text: Miss Thao gave my wife the best Vietnamese head spa experience! She was very accommodating, friendly, and professional throughout the whole service. The staff were also very warm and welcoming, providing truly 10/10 customer service. The place is clean, relaxing, and perfect for anyone who wants to unwind and feel pampered. My wife really enjoyed the experience, and we will definitely come back and become regular clients. Highly recommended
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Sir Mark! We are truly happy to hear that your wife had the best Vietnamese Head Spa experience with Miss Thao. Your kind words about her professionalism, friendliness, and accommodating service mean a lot to us. We’re also glad that you appreciated our warm customer service and relaxing atmosphere. It was our pleasure to pamper your wife, and we’re very excited to welcome you both back again soon. Thank you for your recommendation and support!

reviews.text: I had a Japanese head spa and massage , and also full body massage with the therapist Rowena. Lovely lady, and very professional. reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your gracious feedback Dear Aveen. We are delighted to know that your Japanese Head Spa and full-body massage with Rowena was such a positive experience. Her professionalism, attentive care, and thoughtful approach are truly appreciated, and we are pleased that the treatment helped relieve the tension in your neck. Your kind words will be shared with her, and we look forward to welcoming you again for another relaxing visit.

reviews.text:
The spa is easy to access, although the building itself is dull and gloomy.

The hair spa treatment itself was good . I personally found the interaction a little less welcoming.

The manicurist also did a good job.

However, what really surprised me during my visit was seeing a cockroach inside the spa. I was quite shocked to see this. I have a video of it but I prefer not to attach it and I have shared it with the saloon .

They also have discounts/promotions for the Japanese spa, which may be worth checking if you’re considering trying it.

reviews.author: JC Cortez
reviews.text:
I had such a relaxing and amazing head spa experience at Amorable Beauty Salon. From the moment I came in, the atmosphere was calm, clean, and very soothing. The staff named Thao from Vietnam were very professional, gentle, and made sure I was comfortable the entire time.
The head spa treatment itself was incredible — the scalp massage relieved so much stress, and the products they used smelled great and felt refreshing. I could really feel my scalp being deeply cleansed. After the session, my scalp felt light and refreshed, and my hair was softer and healthier.
Overall, it was a very relaxing experience and definitely worth it. I highly recommend this salon to anyone who wants to relax, de-stress, and take good care of their scalp and hair. I will surely come back again.
